name: Gata Only
blurb: FloyyMenor and Cris MJ's Chilean reggaeton hit, TikTok's top global song of 2024
title: Gata Only by FloyyMenor & Cris MJ: Why It Went Viral on TikTok
description: Gata Only is a 2024 reggaeton song by Chilean artists FloyyMenor and Cris MJ. It spread on TikTok from Chile worldwide and was TikTok's top global song of 2024.
answer: "Gata Only" is a reggaeton song by Chilean singers FloyyMenor and Cris MJ, released as a duet on 2 February 2024. It caught on in Chile, spread across Latin America and then Europe through TikTok dance and lip-sync clips, and TikTok named it its top global song of 2024, with more than 15 million videos. "Gata" literally means "cat" but is slang for a woman, so the title says she is the only one.

body: The sound is a laid-back reggaeton beat with a chorus built around the title, which made it easy to dance or lip-sync to in short clips. FloyyMenor was 18 when it took off, and the song was released independently through UnitedMasters. Its label's A&R head said it went from Chile to Mexico and Argentina, then became huge in Italy, France and beyond.

body.note: FloyyMenor first released the song alone in December 2023. Cris MJ, already established in Chile, heard it and asked to add a verse, and the duet is the version that went viral.

head: Date
Event
rows: FloyyMenor releases a solo version, which is taken down days later.
The duet with Cris MJ comes out as the lead single of FloyyMenor's debut EP, El Comienzo.
It enters Billboard's TikTok Top 50 (16 March) and the Hot 100 at No. 98 (30 March).
A remix with Ozuna and Anitta is released.
It passes 1 billion Spotify streams in 190 days, the fastest Latin song to do so.
TikTok names it the top global song of 2024.

body: In Latin urban music "gata" (cat) is a common word for an attractive woman, and "only" is English for "the only one". FloyyMenor has said he wrote it while missing a former partner, so the title boils down to "she's the only girl for me".

ul: Billboard Hot 100 peak: No. 27. Billboard Global 200 peak: No. 4, the first top 10 for both singers.
No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs, the first No. 1 by a Chilean artist on that chart since 1990, and the chart's top song of 2024 year-end.
Peaked at No. 2 on Spotify's global chart and reached No. 1 in 22 countries.
Won Top Latin Song at the 2024 Billboard Music Awards.

faq.a: Chilean singers FloyyMenor (Alan Galleguillos) and Cris MJ (Christopher Álvarez). FloyyMenor wrote the song, and Cris MJ added his own verse for the duet.

faq.q: What is the "Gata Only" dance on TikTok?
faq.a: There is no single fixed routine. Most clips are easy reggaeton dancing or lip-syncs to the chorus, which helped it spread through millions of everyday videos; a clip of Travis Scott dancing to it in August 2024 also went viral.
Yes, the lyrics are in Spanish; only the word "only" in the title is English. Both singers are from Chile.
